title: Calendar ships the pager navigation model only
context: The design hides three alternative calendar navigation models behind a designer prop, calendarNav: pager (the default), weekmonth and scroll. The live calendar has only previous and next month chevrons.
options: Week/Month toggle with a week view of 7 day cards (recommended)
All three models, chosen in Settings
Scroll through every month with a month rail
outcome: Pager only, chosen by the owner. A month grid with previous and next month, a month-and-year picker opened from the title, a "This week" jump shown when away from the current month, and the arrow-key, T and Esc shortcuts. No week view and no scroll model.
